from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyExpense(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial report with its management expense for categorization."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as written in the report")
    management_expense_yuan: float | None = Field(description="The management expenses amount in yuan as reported")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="The verbatim line containing the management expense value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_expenses: list[CompanyExpense]
